SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
SET @prov5 := (SELECT hoscode FROM sys_config c INNER JOIN chospital h ON c.provincecode=h.provcode AND h.hostype in(1));


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_2q_adl_plus(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	
	1B0270 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0271 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0272 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0273 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

	result9q int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0282 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0283 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0284 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	1B0285 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_2q_adl_plus WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);


INSERT IGNORE INTO s_2q_adl_plus 
SELECT @id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
,@b_year+543 as b_year

,COUNT(DISTINCT t.cid) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270','1B0271','1B0272','1B0273')  ,t.cid,NULL)) result
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0270')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0270
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0271')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0271
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0272')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0272
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0273')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0273

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF( t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0282','1B0283','1B0284','1B0285')  ,t.cid,NULL)) result9q
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0282')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0282
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0283')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0283
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0284')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0284
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0285')  ,t.cid,NULL)) 1B0285


FROM  t_person_cid p 
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.check_hosp=h.hoscode
INNER JOIN tmp_specialpp_2q t  ON p.cid=t.cid AND t.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d 
WHERE  p.check_typearea in(1,3) AND p.NATION in(99) AND p.DISCHARGE in(9)
AND p.age_y >=60 AND t.age_60 =1  AND t.PPSPECIAL in('1B0212') 
GROUP BY h.hoscode;

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("1b0270") as "1b0270" ,SUM("1b0271") as "1b0271" ,SUM("1b0272") as "1b0272" ,SUM("1b0273") as "1b0273" ,SUM("result9q") as "result9q" ,SUM("1b0282") as "1b0282" ,SUM("1b0283") as "1b0283" ,SUM("1b0284") as "1b0284" ,SUM("1b0285") as "1b0285" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
